boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Nevada-Reno
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and coffee stops with publicly posted evening or overnight availability in Reno, including several on North Virginia Street by campus.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on North Virginia
cards.subtitle: 2175 North Virginia Street, north of campus
cards.notes: Use the posted dine-in schedule when you need an evening food stop; confirm holiday changes before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A North Virginia Street option with dine-in hours extending past midnight most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's lists dine-in hours through 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and through 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 2175 North Virginia Street.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — N Virginia St, Reno
cards.access_notes: Posted dine-in hours: 9 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Ruby's Diner across from UNR
cards.subtitle: 1703 North Virginia Street, across from campus
cards.notes: Plan this for a Friday or Saturday evening, when the location's published schedule runs later than its weekday close.
cards.short_summary: A directly across-the-street diner with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruby's Diner identifies its Reno location as across from the University of Nevada, Reno and lists Friday and Saturday hours until 12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are until 12 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Sunday–Thursday close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Rick's Pizza by College Street
cards.subtitle: 1305 North Virginia Street, across from UNR
cards.notes: Check the day before going and use the food menu or ordering link for a pizza, sandwich, salad, or side.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated pizza restaurant directly across from the university with evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: Rick's Pizza states that it is directly across from the University of Nevada, Reno at Virginia and College streets and lists Wednesday–Saturday service until 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 9 p.m. Wednesday–Saturday; verify the schedule before departure.

cards.title: Denny's on North Wells
cards.subtitle: 680 North Wells Avenue, Reno
cards.notes: Choose this round-the-clock diner when an overnight meal is needed; it lists walk-ins and takeout among its services.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Reno diner with breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its restaurant at 680 North Wells Avenue in Reno as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The official Reno location page marks 680 North Wells Avenue as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Denny's on East Plumb
cards.subtitle: 1100 East Plumb Lane, Reno
cards.notes: Use this as another all-hours option and check the restaurant page for ordering and local service information before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A separate 24-hour Denny's location in Reno.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists the restaurant at 1100 East Plumb Lane, Reno as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists every day as open 24 hours.

cards.title: IHOP on South Virginia
cards.subtitle: 1800 South Virginia Street, Reno
cards.notes: Reserve this for weekend or Sunday late availability; the official location page also lists dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A South Virginia Street IHOP with midnight hours on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 1800 South Virginia Street restaurant open until 12 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 12 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday; until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday.

cards.title: IHOP on North McCarran
cards.subtitle: 10150 North McCarran Boulevard, Reno
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the schedule and available ordering modes before traveling to this northwest Reno location.
cards.short_summary: An IHOP option with daily service until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its restaurant at 10150 North McCarran Boulevard in Reno open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. every day.

cards.title: IHOP at South Meadows
cards.subtitle: 9786 South Virginia Street, Reno
cards.notes: For a later dinner window, check this South Virginia location's official schedule and choose dine-in, pickup, or delivery as needed.
cards.short_summary: A South Meadows IHOP with daily hours until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its restaurant at 9786 South Virginia Street, Reno open from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m. every day.

cards.entity_name: Starbucks at Joe Crowley Student Union
cards.title: Starbucks in the Joe
cards.subtitle: Joe Crowley Student Union, UNR campus
cards.notes: Use the union's current vendor-hours page for a campus coffee stop, and account for the separate summer schedule when classes are out.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Starbucks with published weekday service until 9 p.m. during the regular schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joe Crowley Student Union's current hours page lists Starbucks open Monday–Friday from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Joe Crowley Student Union building and vendor hours
cards.access_notes: Regular posted hours are 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday; the page separately lists summer hours until 7 p.m.

cards.title: Keva Smoothies in the Joe
cards.subtitle: Joe Crowley Student Union, UNR campus
cards.notes: Check the union vendor-hours page before going, especially during breaks, then use this first-floor option for an evening smoothie or bowl.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor student-union vendor with regular weekday hours until 8 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joe Crowley Student Union's current hours page lists Keva Smoothies Juice & Bowls open Monday–Friday until 8 p.m.
cards.source_title: Joe Crowley Student Union building and vendor hours
cards.access_notes: Regular posted hours are 8 a.m.–8 p.m. Monday–Friday; confirm break-period changes on the official hours page.
